description: Human genetic variants from Open Targets. A node can represent multiple alleles sharing an rsID; allele-specific values are aligned with ot_variant_ids, and association evidence identifies its specific allele. Variants without an rsID use GRCh38 position and alleles as their identifier.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: dbSNP rsID, using the numerically lowest rsID when several are present; otherwise GRCh38:<CHR>_<POS>_<REF>_<ALT>.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: rsID without the dbSNP prefix, or the Open Targets variant ID when no rsID is available.

common_properties.name: ot_variant_ids
common_properties.description: Open Targets allele identifiers for all variant records sharing this node’s identifier.
common_properties.notes: variantId of every record sharing the key, sorted

common_properties.name: chromosome
common_properties.notes: [assumption] identical for all alleles of a node

common_properties.name: position
common_properties.notes: [assumption] identical for all alleles of a node

common_properties.name: hgvs
common_properties.notes: parallel to ot_variant_ids; "NA" for an allele without value

common_properties.name: most_severe_consequence
common_properties.description: Sequence Ontology label for the most severe predicted consequence of each allele.
common_properties.notes: parallel to ot_variant_ids; "NA" for an allele without value

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing to the node; Open Targets uses OpenTargets.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the node was created or its properties last changed.

source_contributions.scope: Variants linked to a SPOKE Disease through ClinVar assertions or GWAS lead variants, to a SPOKE Gene through molecular QTL lead variants, or to a SPOKE Compound through genotype-level pharmacogenomic annotations. Only evidence with a corresponding endpoint in SPOKE supports inclusion; there are no isolated Variant nodes. Haplotype-only pharmacogenomic records are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Open Targets supplies genomic coordinates, alleles, HGVS notation, predicted consequences, gnomAD population allele frequencies and cross-references. Multiple allele records sharing the node identifier contribute their allele-specific annotations. GWAS and QTL evidence uses lead variants only, without a p-value threshold.
